title: 第22章 年纪不大，胆子不小

第22章 年纪不大，胆子不小-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“砰”的一声，车门关上。

坐在前排的司机启动汽车。

魏沐指尖扣住车窗升降键，把外面的风声隔开。

秦兰今天喝了不少酒，别看这姐姐今年29岁，酒量还没他19岁的时候好。

几杯酒下肚就开始眼神迷离。

秦兰歪着脑袋靠在他的大腿上，她双颊通红，额前的几缕碎发恰到好处的遮盖住紧闭的眼睛。

魏沐的视线在那抹软唇上顿了两秒，喉结上下滚动，鬼使神差地抬起手。

指尖刚碰到那缕碎发，腕子就被人轻轻攥住。

下一秒，秦兰睁开眼睛，好奇的看着他：“你要干什么？”

魏沐手没停，顺势把那缕碎发别到她耳后，指尖不经意蹭过她温热的耳垂。

“你头发乱了，我帮你理一下。”

呵呵....年纪不大，胆子不小。

“连姐姐的主意都敢打？”

秦兰捏着他的耳朵不放手。

“哎呦，姐，我真没干啥。”

“我才不信，你们男人没一个好东西！！”

她又不是傻子，从上次在魔都，她就察觉到这小子言语轻佻，完全不像以前那样老实。

果然啊，在上戏学坏了。

“我就想给你理一下头发。”

魏沐咬死不承认，他确实没想干什么，只是没想到对方反应这么大。

“真的？你刚才不是和霍斯燕聊得挺开心？”

“你说二姐？我们是正常聊天。”

听到这话，秦兰话锋一转，捏着他耳垂的手又紧了点：“一口一个‘二姐’，才第一次见面就这么热络？”

秦兰气不打一处来，她发现自己真的看不懂这个弟弟。

刚才两人的对话她一个字不落的听完，不就是打情骂俏？

这才第一次见面啊。

还有那个霍斯燕，也是个骚狐狸！！

聚会之前，她三番五次强调，不要打她弟弟的主意。

然后呢？一个比一个上手快！！

“姐！！”

With a "bang", the car door closed.

The driver in the front seat starts the car.

Wei Mu pressed the window lift button with his fingertips to block out the wind noise outside.

Qin Lan drank a lot today. Even though this sister is 29 years old, her drinking capacity is not as good as when he was 19 years old.

After a few glasses of wine, my eyes started to blur.

Qin Lan tilted her head and leaned on his lap, her cheeks were flushed, and a few strands of hair on her forehead covered her closed eyes just right.

Wei Mu's gaze paused on the soft lips for two seconds, his Adam's apple rolled up and down, and he raised his hand out of nowhere.

As soon as his fingertips touched the strand of hair, his wrist was gently grasped.

The next second, Qin Lan opened his eyes and looked at him curiously: "What do you want to do?"

Without stopping, Wei Mu tucked the strand of hair behind her ear, and his fingertips inadvertently brushed against her warm earlobe.

"Your hair is messed up, let me straighten it for you."

Haha....You are not old, but you are not timid.

"You even dare to take on your sister's ideas?"

Qin Lan pinched his ears and refused to let go.

"Oh, sister, I really didn't do anything."

"I don't believe it, none of you men are good!!"

She is not a fool. From the last time she was in Magic City, she noticed that this boy was frivolous and not as honest as before.

Sure enough, I learned a lot from the theater.

"I just want to cut your hair."

Wei Mu refused to admit it. He really didn't mean to do anything, but he didn't expect the other party's reaction to be so big.

"Really? Didn't you have a very happy chat with Huo Siyan just now?"

"You mean second sister? We are chatting normally."

Hearing this, Qin Lan changed the topic and pinched his earlobe a little tighter: "You talk about 'Second Sister', how can you be so warm after meeting for the first time?"

Qin Lan was so angry that she found that she really couldn't understand this younger brother.

She listened to the conversation between the two just now without missing a word. Wasn't it just flirting?

This is the first time we met.

And that Huo Siyan is also a naughty fox!!

Before the party, she repeatedly stressed not to have any ideas about her brother.

Then what?One gets started faster than the other!!

"Sister!!"
